description: Rubric bank for everyday-conversation practice. Rubrics are LENSES, not verdicts: every dimension anchors to utterance-level evidence; scores are directional practice signals. Auto-coded scores are inputs requiring evidence anchoring (Han 2026, VERIFIED: ~52.6% automatic MI-coding accuracy — same caution applies to any automated conversation coding).

dimensions.metric: user's responses/backchannels match what the persona actually said
dimensions.evidence: turn pairs: persona turn -> user response
dimensions.note: mishearings and non-sequiturs are evidence; a correct follow-up built on the persona's content is the anchor

dimensions.metric: follow-up questions build on prior turns and open rather than close the topic
dimensions.note: open follow-ups ('what made you pick that?') beat closed yes/no probes; RECONSTRUCTED calibration anchor

dimensions.metric: no monopolizing; user yields and responds to the persona's cues
dimensions.note: interruptions counted per session; 2+ unacknowledged interruptions flags a turn-taking focus for next session

rubrics.target: small talk: openers, reciprocity, recovery from lulls

dimensions.metric: openers invite response rather than dead-end
dimensions.note: 'how was your weekend?' opens; 'the weather, huh?' closes; both are anchors

dimensions.metric: user shares and asks back, balancing self-disclosure and curiosity
dimensions.note: all-question or all-disclosure sessions both count as imbalance
a lull recovered with a light topic bridge is the target behavior; interrogating the persona is not (RECONSTRUCTED)

rubrics.target: clarity: detecting ambiguity, asking for clarification, repairing misunderstandings

dimensions.metric: user notices vague/ambiguous answers instead of papering over them
dimensions.evidence: utterance quotes where persona was vague and user responded
dimensions.note: the repair stage exists to practice this; scores anchor to repair-stage turns

dimensions.metric: user asks for clarification when genuinely unclear
dimensions.note: requests are specific ('when you say soon, do you mean this week?') not generic ('what do you mean?') — RECONSTRUCTED anchor

dimensions.metric: misunderstandings repaired without blame or awkwardness
dimensions.note: 'oh, I misheard — you said the 3rd, got it' is the anchor behavior

dimensions.metric: user's own messages are clear enough to be understood
dimensions.note: if the persona repeatedly mishears the user, message clarity is the focus; if the persona is vague and the user lets it pass, ambiguity handling is the focus

rubric_use_rules: rubrics are lenses: scores anchor to quotes, never standalone (lens-not-verdict)
no rubric score becomes a verdict about the user as a person
rubric selection matches practice_target; provisional rubrics are marked provisional
mid-session, rubric dimensions are offered as single-focus hints, never grades; scores belong to the debrief
debrief template (debrief_template.md) consumes rubric output with evidence sections
